adjudication_disagreement_and_resolution.evidence_reviewer: AGREE with INCONCLUSIVE; all twelve invalid-experiment conditions PASS when the preregistered K6 shared-infrastructure caveat is applied as the lock directs; RETIRE_R06; high confidence.
adjudication_disagreement_and_resolution.red_team: RESULT_ATTACKED: the unqualified Rule Zero clause ('any treatment decision consumes simulator truth') fires at the procedure level because Haplous-only probe episodes receive extra exposure to the K6 truth-triggered capture event (61/70 completed probe sides crossed it; a side of the single accepted pair was oracle-captured); formally INVALID under the literal clause, INCONCLUSIVE only conditional on the K6 waiver.
adjudication_disagreement_and_resolution.resolution: The lock contains both an unqualified invalidity clause and an explicit preregistered K6 caveat that declares the shared capture event internally fair with repair deferred to the next lineage; this contradiction is recorded as a preregistration defect. The experiment is recorded as INCONCLUSIVE UNDER THE PREREGISTERED K6 WAIVER, with the red team objection preserved verbatim in this file. Both readings terminate the probing question identically for campaign purposes: no material execution value was demonstrated, and R06 is retired. The campaign does not pool, rerun, or redesign on this benchmark (anti-thrash rule).

The single guided scenario (s01-r13) succeeded under BOTH arms, from a confidently-wrong estimate (h_err 0.2358 mm, posterior sigma ~0.18 um, NEES 2052290.29, cos-alignment with c0 0.9994).
79/80 scenarios received zero accepted pair updates; 9 complete pairs were gated SALVAGE (NEES 0.273-1.117).
K1 confirmed: complete-pair counts by stratum 0,4,3,1,2 = 0,0,1,4,5; unseatable pair counts 16,16,15,12,11.

r06_disposition.justification: R06 compares the same surviving Haplous execution system with vs without explicit probing. R05-v3 demonstrated zero net execution value of the probing/filter treatment on the locked challenge set: 79/80 scenarios executed the bit-identical baseline fallback, the sole guided execution came from a confidently-wrong estimate in an already-successful scenario, and the K1 geometric bound (complete-pair feasibility impossible for |e|>1.118 mm with the locked 1 mm probe radius and measured R_passive=1.5 mm) structurally removes probing from the only stratum containing production failures. There is no surviving Haplous execution advantage for R06 to isolate. Both independent reviewers recommend retirement. Reconsideration requires a newly preregistered probe geometry or a corrected off-center observation model, not an isolation study.

campaign_consequence: The current online estimation/probing machinery does not earn product execution status on R05-v3 evidence.
Estimator/probing remain preserved as research and commissioning tooling (N2/N5 metrology mode, F1c session driver).
The strongest simpler execution system is the tuned VALIDATED_LOOSE_V1 spiral baseline (v_t=0.1 m/s on the R05 challenge set; canonical 5 mm/s elsewhere).
